text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, I heard there's a zazen meditation
session being held here, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you. Welcome, Grass Wonder.
That being said—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My legs are numb... I-I can't do this anymoreee...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, prolonged zazen meditation is unexpectedly tough.
I usually recommend the shorter course to everyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. In that case,
we'll take the unlimited time course, please~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I had a feeling you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Confront yourself within the darkness. Once you grasp
a state of total selflessness, it will surely aid you in races as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(A state of pure, clear mindfulness...
Where every wicked thought has been purged from the body――)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"—Where am I...
When did I get on the track...?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's fast! So fast, Maruzensky! An absolute monster!
Can no one catch up to her?!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is no one coming?
In that case, I'll just blast my way straight to the top~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Not yet—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: (—Emptying my mind of all thought... I'm nowhere near that.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Because with such greed,
my entire body hungers for the summit...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder! Here comes Grass Wonder!
Can she pull off the late charge—?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Incredible focus, Grass Wonder.
Were you able to achieve a state of pure mind?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...No. Inexperienced as I am,
it seems it is still far too early for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Still... yes.
I believe I was able to reaffirm what truly matters."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The one and only destination—
that I must reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is this also the effect of zazen meditation?
My mind feels crystal clear, without a single cloud~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Grass Wonder devoted herself
to training with even greater zeal.
